diagnosis.reasoning: Request rate and prompt token rate tripled while request shape, prefix cache hit rate, and preemption were all unchanged, so no internal mechanism degraded. The TTFT blowup is almost entirely queue_time (+4227%) with running batch and iteration tokens scaling up and KV usage still low at 0.27, i.e. the server is simply admitting far more work than it can drain. Queueing is the proximate path to the SLI, driven by the enlarged batch composition and modestly higher prefill time, all downstream of the exogenous arrival surge.
